source: Sampled from the client campaign poster (poster.jpg in this folder). Values are medians of the named regions.

darkest.note: Deep navy at the bottom-left corner of the poster and the shaded edges of the gradient.

dark.note: Darker navy behind the lower rows of members and around the edges.

main.note: Main royal blue: left/right margins and most of the poster background (the dominant colour).

main_alt.note: Slightly brighter blue at the bottom-right and mid-gradient areas.

lighter.note: Mid highlight where the gradient lightens, toward the top-centre.

highlight.note: Light sky-blue glow at the top-right corner and behind the title area.

on_blue_primary.note: White, used for the 'انتخابات 2026' headline and the member names.

on_blue_accent.note: Bright yellow, used for the slogan line and the club name/title strokes.

yellow.note: Bright yellow: the members' ties, the lower half of the crest shield, the slogan text.

gold.note: Softer gold-yellow: underline under the headline and warmer text/pocket-square tones.

frame_gold.note: Approximate orange-gold of the vertical frame bars either side of the crest at the top (poster art, estimated).

white.note: White shirts, the crest's white rim and the white band across the shield.

silver.note: Pale grey-silver panel behind the crest (approximate).

suit_navy.note: Near-black navy of the members' suits (approximate); also works for dark text on light surfaces.
